roadmap.title: Story and city counters on Hard
roadmap.description: Play all 12 chapters on Hard (required to unlock Legend later), defeat each chapter boss, and let the passives fill in: Heat Action finishes, picked-up weapons broken, pedestrians knocked down, locker keys, first-person brawls, beach trash and distance run. Start the substory and hostess work here.

roadmap.title: Substories and side content
roadmap.description: Clear all 119 substories and the side activities tied to them: the five masters, weapon modding, hitman requests, the hostess maker, the restaurant dishes and the hostess club run.

roadmap.title: Coliseum and Ultimate Match
roadmap.description: Win every Underground Coliseum tournament, then beat the story's endgame challenge mode: play every Ultimate Match round after finishing the story.

roadmap.title: Minigames and money
roadmap.description: Complete every minigame target for Minigame Master, which sweeps up the individual minigame achievements, and turn the gambling wins into the 10,000,000 yen total.

roadmap.title: Legend playthrough and completion
roadmap.description: After clearing Hard, start a New Game+ on Legend and finish the story again, then claim the final achievement once everything else is done.

achievements.description: Earn every other achievement in the game.
achievements.summary: Earn every other achievement in the game.

guide.context: This reward has no separate requirement and unlocks automatically once the other 49 achievements are earned.

steps.text: Earn the other 49 achievements; this one unlocks as soon as the last outstanding one is claimed.

achievements.summary: Defeat Majima at the end of Chapter 1.

guide.context: Chapter 1 closes with a one-on-one fight against Goro Majima in Kamurocho, and story fights cannot be skipped.

steps.text: Play Chapter 1 until Kiryu faces @enemy{Majima}, then win the fight.

achievements.summary: Defeat Rikiya at the end of Chapter 2.

guide.context: Rikiya Shimabukuro challenges Kiryu near the end of Chapter 2 during the Okinawa section.

steps.text: Play Chapter 2 until @enemy{Rikiya} challenges Kiryu, then win the fight.

achievements.summary: Defeat Tamashiro at the end of Chapter 3.

guide.context: Tamashiro is the Chapter 3 boss, fought on the Okinawa beach as part of the story.

steps.text: Play Chapter 3 until the fight with @enemy{Tamashiro} begins, then win it.

achievements.summary: Defeat Hasebe at the end of Chapter 4.

guide.context: Hasebe leads the fight that closes Chapter 4 in Kamurocho.

steps.text: Play Chapter 4 until Kiryu faces @enemy{Hasebe}, then win the fight.

achievements.summary: Defeat the man in black, Andre Richardson, at the end of Chapter 5.

guide.context: The Chapter 5 boss is introduced only as the man in black; he is Andre Richardson.

steps.text: Play Chapter 5 until the man in black attacks, then defeat @enemy{Andre Richardson}.

achievements.summary: Defeat Kanda at the end of Chapter 6.

guide.context: Kanda is the Chapter 6 boss, fought during the story raid on his offices.

steps.text: Play Chapter 6 until the fight with @enemy{Kanda} starts, then win it.

achievements.summary: Defeat Majima at the end of Chapter 7.

steps.text: Play Chapter 7 until @enemy{Majima} challenges Kiryu, then win the rematch.

achievements.summary: Defeat Lau Ka Long at the end of Chapter 8.

guide.context: Lau Ka Long is the Chapter 8 boss, fought in his hideout.

steps.text: Play Chapter 8 until Kiryu faces @enemy{Lau Ka Long}, then win the fight.

achievements.summary: Defeat Joji Kazama at the end of Chapter 10.

guide.context: Joji Kazama attacks in Chapter 10. He parries and counters, so watch for his guard stance before committing to a combo.

steps.text: Play Chapter 10 until @enemy{Joji Kazama} attacks, then win the fight.

achievements.summary: Defeat Mine at the end of Chapter 12.

guide.context: Mine is the final boss of the story; no other fight follows the Chapter 12 confrontation.

steps.text: Play Chapter 12 through to the final confrontation with @enemy{Mine}, then win the fight.

achievements.summary: Finish the main story.

guide.context: The story spans 12 chapters. Several players report that skipping the final cutscene at Morning Glory can prevent the achievement from registering, so let the ending and credits play out.

steps.text: Complete the final chapter and let the ending run to the credits without skipping.

achievements.summary: Complete 10 substories.

guide.context: Substories are the numbered side stories marked on the map. Any 10 count, and unfinished ones remain available in Premium Adventure after the story.

steps.text: Finish any 10 substories; the achievement pops when the tenth is completed.

achievements.summary: Complete 30 substories.

guide.context: The game contains 119 substories, and any unfinished ones remain playable in Premium Adventure.

steps.text: Finish 30 substories as they unlock through the story and in @mechanic{Premium Adventure}.

achievements.summary: Complete 50 substories.

guide.context: Some substories only start with a specific companion present or at a certain time of day, so swap companions and change the time as you go.

steps.text: Finish 50 substories across the story and @mechanic{Premium Adventure}.

achievements.summary: Complete 80 substories.

guide.context: Two substories need Rikiya with you and one needs Haruka. If a substory will not appear, use Mariko at New Serena, or Saki at Morning Glory, to shift the clock.

steps.text: Finish 80 substories, switching companions and time of day as needed to trigger them.

achievements.summary: Complete all 119 substories.

guide.context: Every substory can still be finished in @mechanic{Premium Adventure}. Two require Rikiya and one requires Haruka, and the final Amon substory opens only after the other 118 are done.

steps.text: Clear the substories as they unlock during the story.
In @mechanic{Premium Adventure}, switch companions and change the time of day to trigger the ones still missing.
Finish all 119, including the final substory against @enemy{Amon}.
steps.note: Mariko at New Serena and Saki at Morning Glory can change the time of day.

achievements.summary: Apprehend every hitman on the hit list.

guide.context: Hitman requests unlock in Chapter 6, when Ibuki leads Kiryu to Kamuro Castle in Nakamichi Alley. Extra requests come from a man near the rear of the Shogi parlor, by the Okinawa monorail.

steps.text: In Chapter 6, meet Ibuki at @loc{Kamuro Castle} in Nakamichi Alley and accept the hitman requests.
Clear each hitman request as it is accepted.
Clear the requests from the man near the rear of the @loc{Shogi parlor} in Downtown Ryukyu, then finish any remaining targets.

achievements.description: Spend 300,000 yen in one visit to a hostess club.
achievements.summary: Spend 300,000 yen in a single visit to a hostess club.

guide.context: A single bottle of Gold Champagne costs more than the required 300,000 yen, so one order completes it.

steps.text: Enter a hostess club, order the @item{Gold Champagne}, and finish the visit.

achievements.summary: Max out one of a hostess's four style gauges in the hostess-maker minigame.

guide.context: Only the style gauges matter: the outfit and accessories must push one style to its maximum. Kirie, found at the east end of Ryukyu Boulevard, starts with a high cute stat and is the easiest pick; Jo at Aqua Sky also works. Using up both girls before unlocking the needed clothing can force a restart of the minigame, so keep one for last.

steps.text: Recruit @npc{Kirie} at the east end of Ryukyu Boulevard, or @npc{Jo} at @loc{Aqua Sky}, as your hostess.
Train her to S rank and unlock the clothing options through normal shifts.
Equip an outfit that maxes one style. For Kirie use @item{One Piece (Purple)}, Loose Curls hair, hair band, heart earrings, Simple necklace, Ribbon corsage, Cute nails, Heart ring and Simple watch.
steps.note: Kirie's set also uses eyebrow style 1 with colour at row 2 column 1, eyelash style 1 with the colour at top left, eyeliner style 3 at row 1 column 2, eye shadow at row 6 column 1, blush at row 2 column 1 and lipstick style 1 at row 1 column 2, with all glitter and colour contacts off.

achievements.description: Open a total of 10 lockers in Kamurocho and Downtown Ryukyu.
achievements.summary: Open 10 coin lockers across Kamurocho and Downtown Ryukyu.

guide.context: Locker keys appear as small glowing pickups on the street, inside buildings and on rooftops, and only 10 openings are needed. Press R3 to raise the free camera when a key is hard to spot. Opening every locker supplies the minigame cheat items used elsewhere.

steps.text: Pick up glowing locker keys around Kamurocho and Downtown Ryukyu.
Take 10 keys to a locker bank marked with a @mechanic{C} on the map and open the matching lockers.

achievements.description: Order the most expensive item in all restaurants.
achievements.summary: Order the most expensive item at every restaurant in Kamurocho and Downtown Ryukyu.

guide.context: Kiryu cannot eat while at full health, so take a few hits or eat squid bait from the Ryukyu market between visits. Where a restaurant lists more than one most-expensive dish, order each of them.

steps.text: In Downtown Ryukyu, order the top-priced dish at Aqua Sky, Blue Seal, Quickly Tea and Boba, Sam's Maui Grill, Smile Burger, Umachi Diner and Waraba Okinawan Soba.
In Kamurocho, order the top-priced dish at Bantam, Cafe Alps, Earth Angel, Gelateria Kamuro, Kanrai, Kyushu No. 1 Star, Matsuya, Pronto, Shellac, Smile Burger and Sushi Gin.
steps.note: Pronto has different top dishes by time of day: Rich Egg Carbonara at day and Jamon Iberico at night.

achievements.summary: Finish 10 battles with a Heat Action.

guide.context: The Heat Action must land the killing blow; only battles ended this way count.

steps.text: Build Heat in a fight, then use a @mechanic{Heat Action} to defeat the last enemy. Repeat until 10 battles have ended this way.

achievements.description: Claim victory in all Coliseum tournaments.
achievements.summary: Win every tournament in the Underground Coliseum.

guide.context: The Coliseum opens in Chapter 8 inside Purgatory. Clearing each tournament three times unlocks the next, and the final Maximum Grand Prix appears after five wins each in Hyper GP and Magnum Force GP. Tag matches need recruited partners, and the Komaki Parry or Tiger Drop makes the later fights far easier.

steps.text: Reach Chapter 8 and enter the Underground Coliseum in @loc{Purgatory}.
Win each tournament three times to reveal the next, including the tag matches once a partner is recruited.
steps.note: A recruited tag partner waits just outside the Coliseum entrance.

steps.text: Win Hyper GP and Magnum Force GP five times each to unlock Maximum GP, then win it.

achievements.summary: Create one modded weapon at Kamiyama Works.

guide.context: Kamiyama teaches weapon modding in Chapter 3 and sells the blueprints and materials needed to craft.

steps.text: Buy a base weapon and a blueprint from @npc{Kamiyama} at Kamiyama Works.
Craft the modded weapon at the workshop.

achievements.summary: Trigger Kiryu's first Revelation.

guide.context: Mack introduces the Revelation system in Okinawa and records the first blog entry when Kiryu completes a Revelation event.

steps.text: Meet @npc{Mack} in Okinawa and complete the first Revelation event he offers.

achievements.summary: Meet each of the five training masters.

guide.context: The five masters are Kamiyama, Yonashiro, Mack, Minamida and Komaki. Meeting them is enough, though their lessons unlock weapon modding, chase training and the IF7 fights.

steps.text: @npc{Kamiyama}: met during Chapter 3, then later found in his upstairs office, on the south side by the Ryudo Family Office.
@npc{Yonashiro}: appears early in Chapter 4 on the large rock at the left end of the Okinawa beach.
@npc{Mack}: teaches Revelations from Chapter 4, and later trains chase skills in West Park in Kamurocho.
@npc{Minamida}: found in Chapter 5 in the small square at the south end of @loc{Champion District}.
@npc{Komaki}: complete the Return to the Dragon Palace substory in Chapter 5, then speak to him at the Dragon Palace.

achievements.summary: Play both the standard and oil massage courses at Love In Heart.

guide.context: Both courses count even if the massage is failed.

steps.text: Go to the Love In Heart parlor in Kamurocho, on North Senryo Avenue, and play the Standard Massage, then the Oil Massage and Ear Cleaning course.

achievements.description: Get a hat trick in darts.
achievements.summary: Throw three bullseyes in a single game of darts.

guide.context: A hat trick means three bullseyes, not three game wins. Darts are found in Downtown Ryukyu at Aqua Sky, and at Bantam in Kamurocho.

steps.text: Start any dart game and land three bullseyes.

achievements.description: Get a break ace in nine-ball pool.
achievements.summary: Sink the nine ball on the opening break in a nine-ball pool game.

guide.context: Pool is played at Aqua Sky in Downtown Ryukyu. The nine ball must drop from the break shot itself, which may take several attempts.

steps.text: Start a nine-ball game at @loc{Aqua Sky} and aim the break shot to pot the nine ball.

achievements.summary: Sing all six karaoke songs.

guide.context: Six songs are available. Karaokekan is in Hatsumachi, Downtown Ryukyu, next to the M Store, and on Senryo Avenue in Kamurocho. Songs can also be sung during hostess dates.

steps.text: Visit a @loc{Karaokekan} and sing each of the six songs once.

achievements.summary: Bowl a turkey, three strikes in a row.

guide.context: A turkey is three consecutive strikes. The high score needed for Minigame Master usually produces one along the way.

steps.text: Bowl a 10-frame game and score strikes on three consecutive throws.

achievements.description: Earn a combined total of 3,000 points in cee-lo, cho-han, koi-koi, and oicho-kabu.
achievements.summary: Earn 3,000 points combined across cee-lo, cho-han, oicho-kabu and koi-koi.

guide.context: Only winnings count, and each game keeps its own total, so losing the money afterward does not remove progress. Raising the maximum bet in the tag games needs 10, 15 and 20 plays, and you must leave and rejoin the table for a new limit. Locker cheat items guarantee wins but only one can be used per session.

steps.text: Win 3,000 tags in total spread across cee-lo, cho-han, oicho-kabu and koi-koi.

achievements.description: Earn a combined total of 3,000 points in poker, roulette, and blackjack.
achievements.summary: Earn 3,000 points combined across poker, roulette and blackjack.

guide.context: Casino games have their maximum bets available from the start, and each keeps its own total, so losing the chips later does not remove progress. The larger totals required for Minigame Master make this come quickly.

steps.text: Win 3,000 chips in total spread across poker, roulette and blackjack.

achievements.description: Win 5 stuffed animals in UFO Catcher and get a high score in a shooting game.
achievements.summary: Win 5 UFO Catcher prizes and reach level 50 in Boxcelios.

guide.context: The UFO Catcher and the shooting game Boxcelios are both in the arcade on Nakamichi Street. UFO prizes reset when you leave and re-enter the arcade or speak to the employee, and the rare Chura-chan and Yummy Bar prizes appear only there.

steps.text: At the Nakamichi Street arcade, win any 5 prizes from the UFO Catcher.
Play @mechanic{Boxcelios} and reach level 50, aiming for the glowing blocks.

achievements.description: Win a game of shogi without ever moving your king.
achievements.summary: Win a shogi match without ever moving your king.

guide.context: Shogi is played at the parlor by the Okinawa monorail. Replaying Challenge 1 is the recommended method because its preset position can be won with a fixed sequence.

steps.text: At the shogi parlor, select Challenge 1 and clear it without moving your king.

achievements.description: Win a hand of mahjong when you only have 1 tile concealed.
achievements.summary: Win a mahjong hand with only one tile concealed.

guide.context: Steal tiles with pon, chi and kan until a single tile is left hidden, then win on that final pair with ron. The result depends on the draws, so it can take several hands.

steps.text: Play a mahjong hand and call pon, chi or kan on every offer.
When only one concealed tile remains, win the hand with ron on that last pair.

achievements.description: Hit 2 panels with one ball in the Hard Game at the batting cage.
achievements.summary: Hit two panels with a single ball in the batting cage's Hard Game.

guide.context: The panels sit in rows, so aim the reticle at the seam between two of them rather than at a panel center.

steps.text: At the batting cage, choose Hard Game and line the cursor up with the seam between two panels.
Swing so the single ball strikes both panels.

achievements.description: Hit a 350-yard drive during a tournament in golf.
achievements.summary: Record a 350-yard drive in a golf tournament.

guide.context: The golf course is reached by monorail in Okinawa. The longer holes leave room to hit a full-power drive with the strongest club.

steps.text: Take the monorail to the golf course and enter the tournament.
On a long hole, use the strongest driver at full power to carry the ball 350 yards.

achievements.summary: Reel in a tuna while fishing off the beach.

guide.context: Tuna are the maguro catch and appear at 100-150m; no other fish reaches that distance, so a cast to 150m is enough. Better bait reduces junk catches, and bait is sold at the Public Market.

steps.text: Fish from the Morning Glory beach and cast out to 150m.
Reel in the tuna when it bites.

achievements.summary: Complete every entry on the minigame completion list.

guide.context: Nineteen minigame completion targets are tracked. The individual minigame achievements cover several of them, and locker cheat items make the gambling targets much faster.

steps.text: Earn a Serene Dragon rating in both massage courses.
Win 18 dart games and 12 pool games, and score 900 or more on each of the six karaoke songs.

Bowl a 200-point game, then reach the gambling targets: 20,000 tags in cee-lo, 20,000 in cho-han, 10,000 in koi-koi, 10,000 in oicho-kabu, 20,000 chips in roulette, and 10,000 chips each in poker and blackjack within a single sitting.
Win every UFO Catcher prize, win 5 shogi games, and earn over 50,000 in one mahjong match.
Score 1,800 or more on all four batting difficulties, finish the golf tournament at -5, catch all eight fish, and reach level 50 in Boxcelios.
Confirm every entry on the completion list is cleared.

achievements.description: Play all rounds in Ultimate Match mode after beating the game.
achievements.summary: Play every round in Ultimate Match mode after finishing the story.

guide.context: Ultimate Match unlocks after the story and is split into five sets: Melee, One-on-One, Challenge, Team and Ultimate, with later sets opening as earlier ones are cleared. S ranks are not required. Reports confirm you only need to attempt each round, so failing the final Ultimate Match still unlocks the achievement after you return to the menu.

steps.text: From the main menu, open @mechanic{Ultimate Match} and clear the Melee and One-on-One sets.
Clear the Challenge and Team sets.
Enter every round in the final Ultimate set; the achievement unlocks once the last one has been played.

achievements.description: Beat the game on Legend difficulty.
achievements.summary: Beat the main story on Legend difficulty.

guide.context: Legend only unlocks after clearing the game on Hard, so a Hard clear must come first; a New Game+ then carries everything into the Legend run. On Legend a defeat or failed chase sends you back to the last save, so save often. Finishing all substories grants the Golden Pistol, and opening all lockers grants the Beads of Good Fortune, which stops random street fights.

steps.text: Clear the story once on @mechanic{Hard} difficulty to unlock Legend.
Start a @mechanic{New Game+} on Legend with a stocked inventory and your completion rewards.
Play the whole story, saving before fights and chase sequences and reloading the last save on any failure.

achievements.summary: Run a total of 42.195km.

guide.context: The distance is cumulative on the save and keeps counting in Premium Adventure, so it fills in naturally while you complete everything else.

steps.text: Keep running and dashing around the cities; the achievement unlocks when the total distance reaches 42.195km.

achievements.summary: Knock 100 people to the ground.

guide.context: Only a collision that fully knocks a pedestrian down counts; most people merely stumble. Skinny men and hunched older men fall most easily, and they must be hit from behind. Do not target the same person twice.

steps.text: Run into pedestrians from behind to knock them down, and keep doing this around Kamurocho and Downtown Ryukyu until the total reaches 100.

achievements.summary: Start 3 street fights by glaring at thugs in first-person mode.

guide.context: The targets are idlers who pace a short beat instead of walking with the crowd. Stand behind one who has not noticed Kiryu, enter first-person, and hold the view on him until he charges.

steps.text: Find an idle thug who has not spotted Kiryu and stand behind him.
Press @mechanic{R3} to look at him in first-person until he runs over and starts a fight.
Win the fight and repeat until 3 battles have been triggered this way.

achievements.description: Break 30 weapons picked up in battle.
achievements.summary: Break 30 weapons you pick up during battle.

guide.context: Only weapons grabbed from the ground during a fight count; bought or equipped weapons do not. Durability falls as you land hits, so keep switching to fresh pickups.

steps.text: In street fights, pick up nearby weapons and attack until each one breaks.
Repeat until 30 picked-up weapons have broken.

achievements.summary: Hold 10,000,000 yen at once.

guide.context: The total must be on hand at one time, not earned cumulatively. Gambling cheat items turn tags and chips into large payouts, and the hostess completion bonuses add more, so this is fastest after the gambling work is done.

steps.text: Earn yen through the story, substories, hostess completion bonuses and gambling.
Keep the balance unspent until it reaches 10,000,000 yen.

achievements.description: Pick up 5 pieces of trash from the beach in front of Morning Glory.
achievements.summary: Collect 5 pieces of trash on the Morning Glory beach.

guide.context: The Morning Glory beach always holds one trash item. Entering the fishing minigame there and choosing not to fish reloads the beach with a new pickup.

steps.text: At the Morning Glory beach, pick up the trash item on the sand.
Enter the fishing spot and cancel, then collect the next item; repeat until 5 are collected.

achievements.description: Pick up 30 pieces of trash from the beach in front of Morning Glory.
achievements.summary: Collect 30 pieces of trash on the Morning Glory beach.

guide.context: The same reload method applies: start the fishing minigame on the beach and quit it to respawn the item. Trash boxes on the beach also count toward the total.

steps.text: Collect the trash item on the Morning Glory beach, then start and cancel the fishing minigame to respawn it.
Repeat until 30 pieces have been picked up.
